deck.name: Nautical Flags
deck.description: International Code of Signals (ICS) — the 26 alphabet flags and their maritime meanings.

cards.label: Alpha (A)
cards.desc: I have a diver down; keep well clear at slow speed.

cards.label: Bravo (B)
cards.desc: I am taking in, or discharging, or carrying dangerous goods.

cards.label: Charlie (C)
cards.desc: Yes / affirmative.

cards.label: Delta (D)
cards.desc: Keep clear of me — I am maneuvering with difficulty.

cards.label: Echo (E)
cards.desc: I am altering my course to starboard.

cards.label: Foxtrot (F)
cards.desc: I am disabled — communicate with me.

cards.label: Golf (G)
cards.desc: I require a pilot. (Fishing vessel: hauling nets.)

cards.label: Hotel (H)
cards.desc: I have a pilot on board.

cards.label: India (I)
cards.desc: I am altering my course to port.

cards.label: Juliet (J)
cards.desc: I am on fire and have dangerous cargo on board — keep well clear.

cards.label: Kilo (K)
cards.desc: I wish to communicate with you.

cards.label: Lima (L)
cards.desc: You should stop your vessel immediately.

cards.label: Mike (M)
cards.desc: My vessel is stopped and making no way through the water.

cards.label: November (N)
cards.desc: No / negative.

cards.label: Oscar (O)
cards.desc: Man overboard.

cards.label: Papa (P)
cards.desc: In harbour: all persons to report on board — vessel about to proceed to sea.

cards.label: Quebec (Q)
cards.desc: My vessel is healthy — I request free pratique.

cards.label: Romeo (R)
cards.desc: No ICS single-letter meaning. Used in combinations.

cards.label: Sierra (S)
cards.desc: I am operating astern propulsion.

cards.label: Tango (T)
cards.desc: Keep clear of me — I am engaged in pair trawling.

cards.label: Uniform (U)
cards.desc: You are running into danger.

cards.label: Victor (V)
cards.desc: I require assistance.

cards.label: Whiskey (W)
cards.desc: I require medical assistance.

cards.label: X-Ray (X)
cards.desc: Stop carrying out your intentions and watch for my signals.

cards.label: Yankee (Y)
cards.desc: I am dragging my anchor.

cards.label: Zulu (Z)
cards.desc: I require a tug. (Fishing vessel: shooting nets.)
